title: Masjid e Khayf
introduction:
MASJID-E-KHAYF

It is one of the exalted mosques of Mina.

Rami-e-Jumrat, sacrificing an animal, shaving one's head or cutting some hair or cutting nails, spending eleventh and twelfth and according to some narrations thirteenth of Zilhajj and other such deeds should be performed in Mina. We have already discussed the recommended deeds of Mina and Masjid-e-Khayf.
